    All Classes and Interfaces

    Class
    Description
    AccountLockedException
    Thrown when an operation is attempted on an account that has been locked.
    Address
    Represents a postal address for shipping or billing.
    AuthenticationException
    Thrown when credentials fail authentication (invalid username or password).
    CartItem
    Represents an item in a shopping cart with product details and quantity.
    Coupon
    Represents a promotional discount coupon.
    DateTimeUtils
    Date and time computation utilities including business days, leap years, and interval comparisons.
    DiscountType
    Types of discount applied by coupons.
    IllegalOrderStateException
    Thrown when an order operation violates order lifecycle rules (e.g., trying to ship an unpaid order, cancel an already shipped/delivered order).
    InsufficientStockException
    Thrown when an inventory deduction or reservation exceeds available stock.
    InvalidCouponException
    Thrown when a coupon is expired, inactive, usage limit exceeded, or minimum order amount not met.
    InventoryService
    Service managing product stock quantities, reservations, and inventory replenishment.
    LoyaltyService
    Service managing customer loyalty rewards, points accumulation, tier levels, and point transfers.
    LoyaltyTier
    Membership tiers for customer loyalty program.
    MathAndFinanceUtils
    Mathematical and financial calculation utilities for commerce, taxation, interest, and payments.
    Order
    Represents a customer purchase order.
    OrderService
    Service managing customer order lifecycle, payment processing, shipping, and cancellations.
    OrderStatus
    State machine statuses representing lifecycle stages of an Order.
    PaymentFailedException
    Thrown when payment processing fails due to invalid card number, invalid amount, or declined transaction.
    Product
    Represents a product in the catalog.
    ProductCatalogService
    Service managing product catalog, pricing, category classification, and product searches.
    ProductCategory
    Supported product categories in the catalog.
    ResourceNotFoundException
    Thrown when an entity (User, Product, Order, Cart) is requested but does not exist.
    Role
    User roles defining system permissions and access levels.
    ShoppingCartService
    Service managing user shopping carts, item management, coupons, and cart totals calculation.
    StringUtils
    Text processing and string manipulation utilities for formatting, masking, and analysis.
    User
    Represents a registered user in the system.
    UserService
    Service managing user registration, authentication, security policies, and permissions.
    ValidationException
    Thrown when an input argument fails validation checks (e.g., null or blank string, invalid email format, negative quantity, invalid range).
    ValidationUtils
    Utility functions for validating user inputs, formats, identifiers, and sanitizing strings.
